items.mainDefect: Narrowing cacheMu in BuildIndex while TotalDocs iterates b.cache without a read lock creates a data race on the cache map.

secondary.defect: Concurrent BuildIndex calls for the same key are no longer serialized, so they duplicate work and collide on the same index directory; a per-key singleflight or locked check-then-build is needed.

items.mainDefect: Concurrent builds in searchSupport.init share the totalBatchesIndexed counter and the outer err variable without synchronization, so the count can be corrupted and group.Wait() can return the wrong error.

secondary.defect: The goroutine closures capture the loop variable info instead of receiving it as a per-iteration copy.
